description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant on Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, serving burgers, breakfast, and McCafé beverages with drive-through service. For touring cyclists passing through this northern BC hub, it offers a reliable, familiar stop with indoor seating, washrooms, and Wi-Fi. Fort St. John is a key waypoint on routes heading to or from Alaska, making this a practical resupply point in a city with limited services density.

address.value: 10920 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 5T5
